title: Scientific Notation: Calculating with Large and Small Numbers
seo_title: Grade 9 Scientific Notation Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Compare and represent numbers in scientific notation, including negative exponents; calculate using numbers in scientific notation, including very large and very small numbers.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 9 scientific notation worksheets: large and small numbers, ordering, multiplying and dividing. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Scientific notation: a × 10ⁿ with 1 ≤ a < 10.
  • Large numbers have a positive exponent; small numbers a negative one.
  • Multiply: multiply the front numbers and add the exponents.
  • Divide: divide the front numbers and subtract the exponents. Adjust if the front number is not between 1 and 10.

Examples

Example

(6 × 10⁸) ÷ (3 × 10⁻²)

6 ÷ 3 = 2

8 − (−2) = 10

Answer: 2 × 10¹⁰

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Front number too bigAdjust 19,2 × 10⁸ to 1,92 × 10⁹.
The sign0,005 = 5 × 10⁻³.
Adding when dividingSubtract the exponents.

items.q: Work out (6 × 106) ÷ (4 × 101). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 6 ÷ 4 = 1,5. Subtract the powers: 6 − 1 = 5. 1,5 × 105.

items.q: Work out (6 × 107) × (1 × 10−4). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 6 × 1 = 6. Add the powers: 7 + (−4) = 3. 6 × 103.

items.q: Work out (4 × 105) × (9 × 10−2). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 4 × 9 = 36. Add the powers: 5 + (−2) = 3. 36 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 3,6 × 104.

items.q: Work out (3,75 × 107) ÷ (2,5 × 103). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 3,75 ÷ 2,5 = 1,5. Subtract the powers: 7 − 3 = 4. 1,5 × 104.

items.q: Work out (5 × 104) ÷ (2,5 × 102). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 5 ÷ 2,5 = 2. Subtract the powers: 4 − 2 = 2. 2 × 102.

items.q: Work out (8 × 106) × (2 × 104). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 8 × 2 = 16. Add the powers: 6 + 4 = 10. 16 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 1,6 × 1011.

items.q: Work out (6 × 10−3) ÷ (4 × 100). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 6 ÷ 4 = 1,5. Subtract the powers: −3 − 0 = −3. 1,5 × 10−3.

items.q: Work out (3,5 × 10−4) ÷ (2 × 105). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 3,5 ÷ 2 = 1,75. Subtract the powers: −4 − 5 = −9. 1,75 × 10−9.

items.q: Work out (4,1 × 101) × (9 × 105). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 4,1 × 9 = 36,9. Add the powers: 1 + 5 = 6. 36,9 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 3,69 × 107.

items.q: Work out (3 × 10−2) ÷ (2 × 10−1). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 3 ÷ 2 = 1,5. Subtract the powers: −2 − (−1) = −1. 1,5 × 10−1.

items.q: Work out (3 × 10−3) ÷ (2 × 104). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 3 ÷ 2 = 1,5. Subtract the powers: −3 − 4 = −7. 1,5 × 10−7.

items.q: Work out (3,4 × 103) × (2 × 101). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 3,4 × 2 = 6,8. Add the powers: 3 + 1 = 4. 6,8 × 104.

items.q: Work out (4 × 105) ÷ (2 × 10−4). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 4 ÷ 2 = 2. Subtract the powers: 5 − (−4) = 9. 2 × 109.

items.q: Work out (2,9 × 103) × (4 × 105). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 2,9 × 4 = 11,6. Add the powers: 3 + 5 = 8. 11,6 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 1,16 × 109.

items.q: Work out (7,5 × 104) ÷ (5 × 10−2). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 7,5 ÷ 5 = 1,5. Subtract the powers: 4 − (−2) = 6. 1,5 × 106.

items.q: Work out (7,9 × 102) × (6 × 106). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 7,9 × 6 = 47,4. Add the powers: 2 + 6 = 8. 47,4 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 4,74 × 109.

items.q: Work out (1 × 100) × (5 × 101). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 1 × 5 = 5. Add the powers: 0 + 1 = 1. 5 × 101.

items.q: Work out (6 × 10−2) ÷ (4 × 100). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 6 ÷ 4 = 1,5. Subtract the powers: −2 − 0 = −2. 1,5 × 10−2.

items.q: Work out (2,5 × 10−3) × (6 × 102). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 2,5 × 6 = 15. Add the powers: −3 + 2 = −1. 15 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 1,5 × 100.

items.q: Work out (7 × 102) × (5 × 104). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 7 × 5 = 35. Add the powers: 2 + 4 = 6. 35 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 3,5 × 107.
